description: Scaffold the Next.js 15 (App Router) + TypeScript web app under web/, wire Neon Postgres access (lazy/runtime), define the full Postgres schema (mirroring the Room entities plus a pgvector knowledge-base table), port the SeedData content (60 questions, 16 careers, 4 cohorts, seed users, RIASEC dimension metadata) to TypeScript, and port the PsychometricEngine scoring math with a Vitest unit-test suite. This is the foundation feature: environment setup + core domain. Everything must build/typecheck/test WITHOUT a live database.
steps: Create web/ as a Next.js 15 App Router + TypeScript project. Set up package.json with scripts: dev (next dev), build (next build), start, lint (next lint), typecheck (tsc --noEmit), test (vitest). Add dependencies: next, react, react-dom, @neondatabase/serverless (Neon serverless driver), and dev deps: typescript, @types/react, @types/node, vitest, eslint, eslint-config-next. Add web/tsconfig.json (strict), web/next.config.* , web/.gitignore (node_modules, .next, .env*.local), and web/vitest.config.ts.

Create web/.env.example documenting required env vars with placeholders and comments: DATABASE_URL (Neon Postgres connection string, e.g. postgres://user:pass@host/db?sslmode=require). Do NOT commit real secrets.

Create web/db/schema.sql as the authoritative Neon schema. Enable pgvector with `CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector;`. Define tables mirroring app/src/main/java/com/example/data/local/entities/AssessmentEntities.kt: assessment_sessions (id text pk, started_at bigint, completed_at bigint null, is_valid bool, reliability_level text, r_score/i_score/a_score/s_score/e_score/c_score real, dominant_code text, dominant_summary text, warning_message text null, top_career_title text null, top_career_affinity real null, ai_analysis text null, cohort_code text null, student_name text null, student_email text null, reviewer_notes text null, review_status text default 'PENDING'); assessment_responses (id bigserial pk, session_id text fk -> assessment_sessions on delete cascade, question_id int, dimension_code text, score int, time_spent_ms bigint, answered_at bigint); ai_config (id int pk default 1, provider_type text, base_url text, api_key text, model_name text, temperature real default 0.7); cohort_groups (code text pk, title text, institution text, creator_name text, created_at bigint, is_active bool default true, description text default ''); app_users (id text pk, email text, display_name text, role text, cohort_code text null, auth_provider text default 'GOOGLE', institution text null). Add a knowledge_documents table (id bigserial pk, title text, source_type text, source_reference text null, created_at bigint, created_by text null) and knowledge_chunks table (id bigserial pk, document_id bigint fk -> knowledge_documents on delete cascade, chunk_index int, content text, embedding vector(1536) null, created_at bigint) with an appropriate index note for pgvector (ivfflat/hnsw cosine). Include indexes matching the Room ones (session_id, question_id).

Create web/lib/db.ts: a lazily-initialized Neon client using @neondatabase/serverless that reads process.env.DATABASE_URL at call time (NOT at module load), throwing a clear error only when a DB call is actually made without DATABASE_URL. Export a query helper. This ensures `next build` succeeds without DATABASE_URL set.

Port RIASEC domain types to web/lib/riasec/types.ts: DimensionCode enum/union ('R'|'I'|'A'|'S'|'E'|'C') with the metadata from PsychometricModels.kt (title, adjective, shortDesc, traits, hex color from Color.kt for each dimension), AssessmentQuestion {id, dimension, text, category, mirrorPairId?}, AssessmentAnswer {questionId, dimension, score, timeSpentMs}, PsychometricScores {r,i,a,s,e,c}, Career (id, title, areaName, description, workEnvironment, ideal{R,I,A,S,E,C}, keySkills[], futureTrends), CareerMatch, QualityMetric, DiagnosticResult. Read the exact ColorRealistic/ColorInvestigative/... hex values from app/src/main/java/com/example/ui/theme/Color.kt and reuse them.

Port seed content to web/data/seed.ts: transcribe ALL 60 questions verbatim (Spanish text, dimensions, mirror pair ids 1<->7,11<->17,21<->27,31<->37,41<->47,51<->57) from SeedData.kt QUESTIONS; ALL 16 careers with their exact ideal vectors, titles, areas, descriptions, workEnvironment, keySkills, futureTrends; the 4 DEFAULT_COHORTS; and DEFAULT_USERS with UserRole values. Also port UserRole and ReviewStatus definitions from UserModels.kt (Spanish titles/descriptions).

Port PsychometricEngine to web/lib/riasec/engine.ts as pure functions faithful to app/src/main/java/com/example/domain/PsychometricEngine.kt: calculateScores(answers, questions) using sum(score-1 coerced [0,4]) / (4*answeredCount) * 100 clamped [0,100] per dimension (0 if none answered); evaluateQuality(answers, questions) reproducing speed trap (avg<1100 AND >=10 timed answers, default avg 2500 when no valid times), straight-lining (maxScoreFreq/count>=0.75 AND count>=15), mirror-pair penalty (+20 if diff>=3, +10 if diff==2, checked once per pair where id<pairId), mirrorConsistencyPercent=(100-penalty) clamped [40,100], isValid and reliabilityLevel ('Alta'/'Moderada'/'Baja') and Spanish warning messages EXACTLY as in Kotlin; matchCareers(scores, catalog) reproducing cosine*0.70 + euclideanProximity*0.30 (euclideanProximity=1-(dist/2.45), per-dim diff/100), dominant-match boost (*1.05 cap 99.5), final clamp [30,99], matchLevel Spanish thresholds (>=88 'Compatibilidad Excelente', >=78 'Alta Afinidad', >=68 'Buena Afinidad', else 'Afinidad Moderada'), sorted desc, and the zero-vector fallback (all 50f, 'Moderada'); getDominantCode(topCount) and getDominantDimensions; getDominantProfileDescription(dominantCode) with the exact 2-letter Spanish map.

Create web/tests/engine.test.ts (Vitest) covering: dimension score formula (e.g. all-5 answers -> 100, all-1 -> 0, mixed -> expected value), zero/empty answers, straight-lining detection at >=15 monotone answers, speed-trap trigger at avg<1100 with >=10 timed answers, mirror-pair penalty math and clamping to [40,100], career matching produces sorted results in [30,99] with correct matchLevel labels, dominant-dimension boost applied, and getDominantProfileDescription mapping for a known code (e.g. 'IRA' -> 'IR' branch text). Tests must fail if the formula is reverted.
acceptance_criteria: `cd web && npm run typecheck` passes with no errors.
`cd web && npm run test -- --run` passes all engine tests.
`cd web && npm run build` succeeds with NO DATABASE_URL set (DB init is lazy).
web/db/schema.sql contains all mirrored tables plus knowledge_documents/knowledge_chunks with a vector(1536) column and CREATE EXTENSION vector.
web/data/seed.ts contains all 60 questions with correct mirror pairs and all 16 careers with exact ideal vectors.
findings: Scaffolded Next.js 15.5.24 + React 19 App Router under web/ with npm. Ported PsychometricEngine.kt -> web/lib/riasec/engine.ts (pure functions), PsychometricModels.kt + Color.kt + UserModels.kt -> web/lib/riasec/types.ts (DIMENSION_META carries exact hex colors), SeedData.kt -> web/data/seed.ts (all 60 questions + mirror pairs, 16 careers with exact ideal vectors, 4 cohorts, 4 seed users). web/db/schema.sql mirrors the Room entities plus knowledge_documents/knowledge_chunks (embedding vector(1536), CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector, HNSW cosine index). web/lib/db.ts is lazy: neon() is created only when a query runs, so `next build` passes without DATABASE_URL (verified with DATABASE_URL unset). Verification all green: npm install, npm run typecheck, npm run lint, npm run test -- --run (20 tests pass), npm run build. Notes/deviations: (1) vitest.config.ts needed a '@' -> project-root alias so the '@/...' TS path imports resolve in tests. (2) Added web/.eslintrc.json (extends next/core-web-vitals) so `next lint` runs non-interactively. (3) neon()'s .query typing is not exposed on NeonQueryFunction, so the query() helper casts the client to reach .query. (4) getDominantProfileDescription fallback only triggers on same-letter 2-letter prefixes (all distinct cross-pairs are mapped); the fallback test uses 'RRC'.
